concepts.gloss_en: Complete/perfect repentance — the state or level of teshuva itself (identified with Shabbat, total rest, rejecting evil entirely)

members.note: representative; the abstract concept of complete repentance

concepts.gloss_en: One who performs complete repentance — the penitent/agent, not the state of teshuva itself

members.note: different construct head: the doer (עושה) of teshuva, an agent/person, not the state itself (rule 4: action/agent about X ≠ X)

notes: Both appear in lm1:79 but denote different things: the state (תשובה שלמה) vs. the one performing it (עושה תשובה שלמה). Kept separate per rule 4.
